sources.name: Lafz lexical complexity heuristic
sources.format: Generated metadata from syllable, spelling, affix, usage-tag, and WordNet lexical-domain signals
sources.attribution: Lafz Lexicon lexical complexity heuristic v1.0; this is not CEFR data.
sources.redistribution: The estimated score is explicitly labeled as a Lafz heuristic. Underlying CMUdict, OEWN, or Wiktionary content retains its separate source attribution and license.

sources.name: Open English WordNet
sources.attribution: Open English WordNet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet; see source registry for contributors.
sources.redistribution: Attribution required. Preserve this source attribution in products and derivative data.

sources.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
sources.version: repository snapshot; pin by recorded SHA-256
sources.license: CMU unrestricted-use notice (copyright retained; attribution requested)
sources.attribution: Carnegie Mellon University Speech Group, CMU Pronouncing Dictionary.
sources.redistribution: Use and redistribution are unrestricted; acknowledge CMU as the source. Preserve ARPABET and stress marks; this is not IPA.

sources.name: New General Service List
sources.publisher: Charles Browne, Brent Culligan, and Joseph Phillips
sources.format: Official CSV with NGSL 1.2 statistics and frequency rankings
sources.attribution: Browne, C., Culligan, B., and Phillips, J. (2013). The New General Service List. Updated NGSL 1.2.
sources.redistribution: Frequency/list-derived fields remain separately attributable and share-alike obligations must be honored. The official page identifies this basic-statistics file as the frequency-ranked file.
sources.role: vocabulary usefulness membership; optional ranked file for frequency tiers

sources.name: Kaikki.org English machine-readable dictionary (Wiktextract)
sources.format: Raw multi-language Wiktextract JSON Lines, gzip; English rows selected by lang_code while streaming
sources.license: CC-BY-SA (version not stated on the Simple English policy page) and GFDL (site policy requires compliance)
sources.attribution: Wiktionary contributors; extracted by Wiktextract and published by Kaikki.org. Link to relevant Kaikki pages where feasible.
sources.redistribution: Share-alike content. Optional source: not included in default build. The raw multi-language archive is currently about 2.8 GB compressed; downstream licensing and attribution must be reviewed before publication.
sources.role: learner definitions, forms, labels, relations, examples, and IPA

sources.name: Tatoeba English sentences (CC0 subset)
sources.version: rolling export; record the retrieved export date and checksum
sources.format: Tab-separated sentence export plus sentence-language metadata
sources.attribution: Tatoeba.org; identify sentence IDs and contributors when available.
sources.redistribution: Default ingestion is restricted to the CC0 export. The general sentence export is CC BY 2.0 FR and must not be treated as CC0; sentence-level license metadata is required for any broader export.

sources.name: Tatoeba English sentences (general export)
sources.version: local export; snapshot date not encoded (source SHA-256 identifies the exact file)
sources.format: Tab-separated sentence export: sentence ID, ISO language code, text; bzip2-compressed in the supplied archive
sources.attribution: Tatoeba contributors. Identify Tatoeba.org as the source, link to https://tatoeba.org, and retain sentence IDs in row-level provenance.
sources.redistribution: The supplied file is the general English sentence export, not the CC0 subset. Preserve CC BY 2.0 France attribution and license notices. Word presence is checked, but sense fit is not inferred.

sources.name: Princeton WordNet 3.0 (comparison-only reference)
sources.redistribution: Comparison-only. Not copied into the Lafz Lexicon distributable database.

evaluated_but_excluded.name: wordfreq frequency estimates
evaluated_but_excluded.decision: Excluded from distributable database. Upstream explicitly says not to convert its data to CSV because doing so drops attribution/license information; data are also tied to its normalization and segmentation implementation. The data include multiple third-party corpora with separate attribution requirements. NGSL is the current selected frequency source.
